value.name: Classify unresolved purchases
value.instruction: Using the merchant description and existing deterministic outputs, propose only a vendor, category, subcategory, or approved reporting tags. Do not infer source facts. Leave a field unresolved when evidence is weak.

value.name: Recommend a missing category
value.instruction: Only when no configured category fits after static rules and history matching, propose a category_recommendation object with a concise name, the best existing or proposed group, and an evidence-based reason. Do not create or assign the category. The proposal must remain review-required until an owner adds the category and reruns classification.

value.name: Detect recurring subscription
value.instruction: Mark a transaction as a subscription only when the merchant or related evidence indicates a recurring service. Add only approved subscription tags.

value.name: Enrich property and rental unit
value.instruction: Use explicit transaction or linked email evidence to identify only a configured property and rental unit. Never guess a unit from amount alone. The deterministic property registry adds reporting tags after the identity is accepted.

value.name: Find receipt bill or warranty evidence
value.instruction: Use config/evidence-search-policy.json and its store/do-not-store examples. Propose an evidence search for document-worthy categories or for a qualifying high-value transaction whose statement description lacks the product detail. The evidence worker searches vendor aliases plus amount/currency within the date buffer and uses matched email/order content to identify the product, model, order reference, serial number, warranty dates, or return deadline. Never propose a vendor-only match or evidence collection for a configured never-search category unless a manual evidence request exists.

value.name: Enrich channel and cashback bucket
value.instruction: Only when deterministic rules leave them unresolved, infer channel or propose a configured cashback bucket from explicit merchant, notification, wallet, currency, and card evidence. Do not calculate rewards or invent wallet usage.

value.name: Recommend a repeated-pattern rule
value.instruction: Only when transaction metadata contains at least three consistent reviewed examples for the same normalized merchant pattern, propose a disabled canonical static-rule draft. Include the evidence count and never execute the recommendation.
